questions.definition: A **warm-up** is a short activity or exercise done at the beginning of a session to prepare the body for more intense activity.
options: a warm, dry place to rest after work
a period of intense exercise after a meal
a gentle activity to get ready for exercise

questions.definition: When someone **lets something slip**, they accidentally reveal a secret or something they were keeping hidden.
A **relic** is an object from a past era, often of historical or cultural significance.
options: a modern invention used for entertainment
a piece of clothing from the 19th century
an old item kept for its historical value

questions.definition: If you **take it upon yourself** to do something, you decide to do it without being asked or told to.
options: ask someone else to do it for you
volunteer to do something without being asked

questions.definition: A **slump** in the economy means there has been a sudden drop in economic activity, often leading to fewer jobs and lower spending.
options: a period of steady economic growth
a sudden decline in business and employment
